scope: Western Allied ground formations and active Western airbases only
quality_policy: v + min(10, floor((100-v)/2)); ground combat units only; aircraft, pilots, HQ and ship crew are unchanged.
limits: Ground quality changes are scenario balance choices, not historical measured statistics or a completed balance test.
Shared Nation12 replacement training and national-morale rules remain; these edits adjust stored unit values only.
Opening stocks are a one-time initialization; recurring resupply still uses native logistics.
Fuel needs were read from a native first-invasion save; requirements are recalculated when loading.
First-turn airdrop UI selection, aircraft capacity, air execution and actual defensive naval fire still need a combined runtime check.
No destroyed formation is resurrected; the diagnostic copy starts before the reported destruction.
